title: Rav Chama bar Tuvia
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Sanhedrin 52b relates that Imarta daughter of Tali, a priest’s daughter, committed adultery; Rav Chama bar Tuvia surrounded her with bundles of vine shoots and burned her. Rav Yosef said: “He erred in two things,” etc. Hyman infers from this that he was the head of his town.
